scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --reload --port 8000
scripts.quality:web: bun run lint:web && bun run format:check:web && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:check:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy app
scripts.quality:api: bun run lint:api && bun run format:check:api && bun run typecheck:api && bun run test:api
scripts.quality: bun run quality:api && bun run quality:web
